children: MDB Capital's net operating revenue shifted to a loss from income year over year, while its net loss widened. Investment banking fees were $333K versus none in the prior-year quarter, but unrealized investment-security losses shifted to $1.0M from a $1.2M gain; the equity-method investee loss also increased, including a $9.86M impairment charge.
¹ Reported as “Total operating income (loss), net”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to MDB Capital Holdings, LLC”.
: Fee income was $333K; no offerings closed in the prior-year quarter.
: Unrealized losses were $1.0M, versus a $1.2M gain a year earlier, reflecting mark-to-market declines.
: MDB recorded a $9.86M impairment charge in the quarter as the share price remained below cost basis since May 2026.
: M1 remained in pre-clinical development, conducting feasibility studies, iterative testing and drug safety and toxicity data collection.
